messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — partner svc 'metrics-proxy' tripped per-key hard cap this morning, 429s to downstream. Noticed multiple retries.
Mira Patel: Link to logs? Could be burst pattern from their ETL job.
Alex Kim: https://logs.redwood.internal/.../search?q=metrics-proxy+429
Tony Chavez: saw alert in the console. Quota usage shot up at 02:14 UTC, sustained for ~3m.
Priya Nair: They requested a temporary lift for onboarding. We gave a soft top-up earlier but maybe TTL expired.
Dana Mills: What's the ask? manual override or make a partner-exempt rule?
Alex Kim: They want quick lift while they roll out backoff. Prefer automated short-lived overrides with audit.
Mira Patel: +1 on short TTL. We should avoid creating permanent exemptions.
Tony Chavez: Proposed flow: request -> approver (oncall) -> console one-click override -> auto-revoke after TTL.
Priya Nair: Audit metadata: who approved, reason, previous qps, TTL, route scope.
Dana Mills: Also need telemetry hooks so billing and latency dashboards show the lifted period.
Alex Kim: Agree. Also need guardrails: limit to specific routes (embedding vs generation), not org-wide.
Mira Patel: UX: in Console rollout tab, show 'Temp Limit' with fields: key, routes, qps, duration, approver, notes.
Tony Chavez: For emergency, oncall should be able to approve via Slack slash command + MFA. e.g., `/override key=abc qps=200 dur=1h reason="onboarding"`
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Override request received from @Priya Nair for key abc123. Waiting approval.
Alex Kim: Security note: record KMS requestor id, and write change to audit-log S3 with integrity checksum.
Mira Patel: Implementation: add a new table overrides(key_id, route_pattern, qps, expires_at, approver, note, created_at)
Priya Nair: We should reuse existing rate-limiter code path, prefer feature flag so we can A/B test.
Dana Mills: Dev plan: patch rate-limiter to check overrides first, then quota. Tests: unit + integration + chaos test under load.
Tony Chavez: Rollout: feature-flagged in prod for 48h, ops watchlist, then enable console UI for SRE only.
Alex Kim: Metric hooks: emit metrics.override.active, overrides.granted.count, overrides.revoked.count, override.latency_impact
Mira Patel: Also add alert if overrides exceed 10/hour or if overrides cause sustained increase in token costs.
Priya Nair: Partner comms: give them a 1h window to revert behavior; if repeated, we require them to implement backoff/queueing.
Dana Mills: Edge case: partner uses multiple keys to circumvent limits. Add per-org aggregate quota check.
Tony Chavez: Agree — enforce both per-key and per-org caps. Overrides can only increase per-key up to per-org max.
Alex Kim: Can we mock up console UX this afternoon? I'll sketch wireframe.
Mira Patel: I'll draft the runbook for oncall approvals and revoke process.
Priya Nair: I'll coordinate partner messaging and ask them to roll out exponential backoff.
infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Override abc123 approved by Tony Chavez. Expires in 59 minutes. Logged id=ovr_20260313_001
Alex Kim: Thanks team — let's track as a short epic: overrides + audit + UX + telemetry.
Dana Mills: Created ticket INF-4827 and linked runbook.
Tony Chavez: Leaving a note: prefer revocation webhook so partners can be notified automatically.
Mira Patel: Added to RFC draft. Will share link shortly.
Priya Nair: Great, will keep partner in the loop. Closing for now.
